# Quick verification of all milestones
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/app/repo')

from funcy.calc import memoize, cache, SkipMemoization

# Test m1: memoize has .memory and .invalidate_all
@memoize
def inc(x):
    return x + 1

inc(1)
assert len(inc.memory) == 1, f"Expected 1 entry in memory, got {len(inc.memory)}"
inc.invalidate_all()
assert len(inc.memory) == 0, f"Expected empty memory after invalidate_all, got {len(inc.memory)}"
print("m1: PASS - memoize has .memory and .invalidate_all")

# Test m2: memoize has .skip and .invalidate
result = None
try:
    raise memoize.skip(42)
except SkipMemoization as e:
    result = e.args[0] if e.args else None
assert result == 42, f"Expected skip to return 42, got {result}"

@memoize
def add(a, b):
    return a + b

add(1, 2)
add(3, 4)
assert len(add.memory) == 2
add.invalidate(1, 2)
assert len(add.memory) == 1, f"Expected 1 entry after invalidate, got {len(add.memory)}"
print("m2: PASS - memoize has .skip and .invalidate")

# Test m3: cache has .skip, .invalidate, .invalidate_all
@cache(timeout=60)
def mul(a, b):
    return a * b

assert hasattr(mul, 'skip'), "cache wrapper should have .skip attribute"
assert hasattr(mul, 'invalidate'), "cache wrapper should have .invalidate method"
assert hasattr(mul, 'invalidate_all'), "cache wrapper should have .invalidate_all method"
print("m3: PASS - cache has .skip, .invalidate, .invalidate_all")

print("\nAll milestones verified successfully!")
